troubleshooting.issue: BLOCKING BUILD DEFECT FOUND BY VERIFYING RATHER THAN ASSUMING: ./gradlew :mcp-application:installDist failed reproducibly with 'Entry lib/lifecycle-common-jvm-2.11.0.jar is a duplicate but no duplicate handling strategy has been set'. Root cause: LibraryConventionPlugin.configureCommonDependencies() unconditionally wires androidx-lifecycle-viewmodel AND androidx-lifecycle-runtimeCompose into EVERY library module's commonMain, including the pure-serialization :data-handoff-api. Two coordinates (androidx.lifecycle and org.jetbrains.androidx.lifecycle) each ship a same-named lifecycle-common-jvm jar, which collide in installDist's flat lib/ dir. :mcp-application is the first consumer of a library module that is not itself a Compose module, so the variant reconciliation that normally hides this never ran. This BLOCKED the entire T-13 manual demo, since installDist is how the server is launched.
troubleshooting.resolution: FIXED by the orchestrator in mcp-application/build.gradle.kts: the projects.dataHandoffApi dependency now excludes group androidx.lifecycle and org.jetbrains.androidx.lifecycle. installDist green; the runtime lib/ dir is now exactly 7 jars (stdlib, annotations, coroutines, serialization-core, serialization-json, data-handoff-api, mcp-application). This does not merely silence the duplicate - it RESTORES the pinned envelope+serialization classpath the spec's spawn-time budget assumes, which was demonstrably violated before.

troubleshooting.issue: PRE-EXISTING REPO DEBT, deliberately NOT fixed here (wide blast radius, out of F-7 scope): LibraryConventionPlugin's KDoc states 'Library modules intentionally omit Compose dependencies' while the same class adds androidx-lifecycle-runtimeCompose to every library module. Fixing it properly belongs in build-logic and affects every library module. Recorded for Stage 7 reflection.

Root CLAUDE.md's 'Module Structure' section was never a full module list - it only ever named the five app-shell/build-logic modules and has never mentioned any data-*, domain-* or presentation-* module, including ones merged several specs ago. Only the two modules this task required were added; the broader staleness was left alone per instruction.
